summary: Air T Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a series of transactions involving its aviation asset management platform. On June 10, 2026, through subsidiary Crestone Air Partners, LLC, it acquired Arena Aviation Partners B.V. and reorganized its Crestone Asset Management LLC ownership. Air T and management affiliate AGI acquired the MRC Parties' 10% common interest in CAM for $6.2 million aggregate cash, with each contributing $3.1 million. Air T and AGI then redeemed ~99% of their CAM common interests. The acquisition broadens Air T's aviation asset management capabilities. Watch for integration metrics and potential future platform growth.
